Best Long & Short EntriesScanning all assets...
Loading best long/short entries...

Entry logic: STRICT EMA 50 / EMA 200 crossover + RSI threshold. Long = EMA 50 crosses above EMA 200 while RSI is below 30. Short = EMA 50 crosses below EMA 200 while RSI is above 70. Stop loss and take profit use ATR-based risk/reward. Not financial advice — confirm manually before trading.

Regulatory headline classification is deterministic and informational; unavailable mandatory feeds always block entries.
Strict sequence: live regulatory news + Bitcoin context + XRP funding + overall crypto conditions produce a 0–100 Market Pulse. Technical evaluation is locked unless directional readiness is 50–84, funding is aligned, and large-order whale flow confirms the 4H direction. Only then may completed 5M/15M candles pass the existing 4H 21/200 trend → liquidity sweep → close-confirmed BOS → first retest → 9/21 cross → volume → VWAP → directional close sequence. Missing or unavailable mandatory data produces WAIT, never a fabricated entry. Educational analysis only.

This is a standalone PDH / PDL / completed-4H reaction model. It does not reuse AI Backtested Entries or Best Long & Short Entries logic. The percentage is a transparent setup estimate—not a guaranteed win rate—built only from level reaction quality, execution-candle structure, trend/VWAP context, relative volume, volatility, session liquidity, and available reward-to-risk. Session data can modify confidence but cannot create a trade by itself.

Fast tab uses 1m, synthetic 2m, 5m, synthetic 10m, 15m, and 30m. Entry = EMA 21 crosses EMA 200. Exit = EMA 9 crosses EMA 200. Each displayed cross price is the candle close that confirmed that crossover. Synthetic 2m candles are built from 1m candles and synthetic 10m candles are built from 5m candles so the layout and logic stay unchanged.

⏱ Candle Countdown

UTC-aligned closes · open several timeframes at once

Layout
Timers use the device clock and standard UTC candle boundaries. Weekly candles reset Monday at 00:00 UTC; monthly candles reset on the first day of the next UTC month.
